meditation.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

Santa y bienaventurada Santa Elena, por la angustia y la devoción con que buscaste la Cruz de Cristo, te suplico que me alcances la gracia de Dios para sufrir con paciencia los trabajos de esta vida, de modo que por ellos, y por tu intercesión y protección, pueda buscar y llevar la cruz que Dios ha puesto sobre mí, para servirle en esta vida y gozar de su gloria para siempre.

Amén.

Oh Dios mío, mi Salvador y mi Glorificador, fuiste un bienhechor tan generoso en el santo madero de la Cruz, donde derramaste tu preciosa Sangre por mi salvación.

Derrama sobre mi alma, en la hora de mi muerte, aunque sea una gota de tu Sangre, para que muera en tu gracia; y luego, asistido por la intercesión de mi protectora y abogada Santa Elena, concédeme lo que ahora te pido en esta oración: (menciona tu petición aquí…), si conviene para tu honra y gloria y para el bien de mi alma.

Amén.

Tú encontraste el tesoro del que nos habla el Evangelio, pues encontraste la Cruz de Cristo.

Que también nosotros encontremos ese tesoro, Cristo vivo en nosotros.

Amén.

Padre nuestro.

Dios te salve, María.

Gloria al Padre.

Gloriosa Santa Elena, admiramos tu vida fiel.

Dios quiso que tu hijo llevara la fe de Cristo al Imperio romano y que un día tú encontraras el magnífico madero de la verdadera Cruz en la que murió Jesús.

Alcánzanos de Jesús fortaleza para nuestra fe y un gran amor a la Cruz.

Que ninguna contradicción ni dificultad nos aparte de Jesús.

Todo esto te lo pedimos por Jesucristo nuestro Señor.

Amén.

En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.
meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Holy and blessed St Helena, with the anguish and devotion with which you sought the Cross of Christ, I plead that you give me God’s grace to suffer in patience the labors of this life, so that through them and through your intercession and protection, I will be able to seek and carry the cross which God has placed upon me, so that I can serve Him in this life and enjoy His Glory ever after.

Amen.

O my God, my Savior and Glorifier, You were such a generous benefactor on the Holy Wood of the Cross, where you spilled Your Precious Blood for my salvation.

Pour upon my soul, at the hour of my death, but a drop of Your Blood so that I die in Your grace and then, assisted by the intercession of my protector and advocate Saint Helena, grant to me what I now ask You for in this prayer (mention request here…), if it be expedient for Your honor and glory and for the benefit of my soul.

Amen.

Saint Helena, who upon opening your mind and heart to the light of the Gospel and upon finding the wood of the true Cross was converted into the model of all the Christian virtues, help us to break the attachments of sin, and to return to the arms of God our Father.

You found the treasure that the Gospel tells us about, since you found the Cross of Christ.

May we also find that treasure, Christ living within us.

Amen.

Our Father

Hail Mary

Glory Be

Glorious Saint Helena, we admire your faithful life.

God willed that your son would bring the faith of Christ to the Roman Empire and that one day you would find the magnificent wood of the true Cross on which Jesus died.

Obtain for us from Jesus strength for our faith and a great love for the Cross.

May no contradiction or challenge distance us from Jesus.

We ask you all this through Jesus Christ our Lord.

Amen.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Amém.

Amém.

Ó meu Deus, meu Salvador e Glorificador, fostes tão generoso benfeitor no Santo Lenho da Cruz, onde derramastes o Vosso Precioso Sangue pela minha salvação.

Derramai sobre a minha alma, na hora da minha morte, ainda que uma só gota do Vosso Sangue, para que eu morra na Vossa graça; e então, assistido pela intercessão da minha protetora e advogada Santa Helena, concedei-me o que agora Vos peço nesta oração: (mencione o pedido aqui…), se for conveniente para a Vossa honra e glória e para o bem da minha alma.

Amém.

Encontrastes o tesouro de que nos fala o Evangelho, pois encontrastes a Cruz de Cristo.

Que também nós encontremos esse tesouro, Cristo vivendo em nós.

Amém.

Pai-Nosso.

Ave-Maria.

Glória ao Pai.

Gloriosa Santa Helena, admiramos a vossa vida fiel.

Deus quis que o vosso filho levasse a fé de Cristo ao Império Romano e que um dia encontrásseis o magnífico lenho da verdadeira Cruz na qual Jesus morreu.

Alcançai-nos de Jesus força para a nossa fé e um grande amor à Cruz.

Que nenhuma contradição ou desafio nos afaste de Jesus.

Tudo isso vos pedimos por Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.

Amém.

Em nome do Pai, do Filho e do Espírito Santo.

Amém.

Amém.

prayer.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Pour upon my soul, at the hour of my death, but a drop of Your Blood so that I die in Your grace and then, assisted by the intercession of my protector and advocate Saint Helena, grant to me what I now ask You for in this prayer (mention request here…), if it be expedient for Your honor and glory and for the benefit of my soul.

Amen.

Saint Helena, who upon opening your mind and heart to the light of the Gospel and upon finding the wood of the true Cross was converted into the model of all the Christian virtues, help us to break the attachments of sin, and to return to the arms of God our Father.

You found the treasure that the Gospel tells us about, since you found the Cross of Christ.

May we also find that treasure, Christ living within us.

Amen.

Our Father

Hail Mary

Glory Be

God willed that your son would bring the faith of Christ to the Roman Empire and that one day you would find the magnificent wood of the true Cross on which Jesus died.

Obtain for us from Jesus strength for our faith and a great love for the Cross.

May no contradiction or challenge distance us from Jesus.

We ask you all this through Jesus Christ our Lord.

Amen.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.
